name: toggle-group
title: ToggleGroup
purpose: Connect exclusive or multiple persistent pressed-state actions with direct pointer affordance.

composition.selection: Single mode emits one id and optionally allows empty selection; multiple mode emits an immutable id array.
composition.keyboard: Roving tabindex follows the selected or first enabled item and supports axis-aware arrows, Home, End, and wrapping.

accessibility: Keep every option label explicit even when an icon is present.
Skip disabled items during roving focus.
commonMistakes: Passing an array model in single mode.
Using ToggleGroup for unrelated one-shot actions.
